NETWORK: Can't reach the server. Check the Wi-Fi and try again.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields are missing or incorrect.
SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong PINs. Try again later.
PIN_LOCKED_MINUTES_one: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {{count}} minute.
PIN_LOCKED_MINUTES_other: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {{count}} minutes.
PIN_NOT_SET: This person has no PIN yet. A manager can set one.
LOCATION_FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to this location.
APPROVAL_INVALID: The approval expired. Ask a manager again.
ROLE_NOT_GRANTABLE: You can't give someone this role.
CANNOT_CHANGE_SELF: You can't change your own role or deactivate yourself.
EMAIL_TAKEN: Someone else already uses this email.
IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS: Still processing the request. Wait a moment.
INVALID_IMAGE: Upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo up to 5 MB.
CATEGORY_NOT_EMPTY: Move or delete the items in this category first.
INVALID_REFERENCE: One of the choices no longer exists. Refresh the page.
IMPORT_INVALID: Some rows could not be imported. Check the errors.
AREA_NOT_EMPTY: Move or delete the tables in this area first.
TABLE_OCCUPIED: This table has guests. Choose a free table.
NOT_YOUR_TABLE: This table belongs to another waiter.
SESSION_STATE: The table cannot change to that state now.
BALANCE_DUE: Settle the bill before closing the table.
CONFLICT: This clashes with another change. Refresh.

fields.email: Enter a valid email, e.g. name@restaurant.al.
fields.pin: The PIN must be exactly 4 digits.
fields.nipt: NIPT looks like L12345678A (letter, 8 digits, letter).
fields.passwordLength: The password needs at least 8 characters.
fields.time: Enter the time as HH:MM, e.g. 07:30.
fields.credentialsRequired: Enter a password, a PIN, or both.
fields.timeRange: Fill in both times, or leave both empty.
fields.dateRange: The end date must be after the start date.
fields.minMax: The minimum cannot be larger than the maximum.
fields.requiredMin: A required group needs a minimum of at least 1.
fields.maxOptions: The maximum cannot exceed the number of options.
fields.percentMax: The discount cannot be more than 100%.
fields.outsideFloor: The table goes outside the floor plan.
fields.transferTarget: Choose a table or a waiter.

ORDER_ITEM_ALREADY_SENT: This item was already sent to the kitchen. Void it instead.
ORDER_ITEM_STATE: This item cannot change like that any more. The screen has been refreshed.
COMBO_INVALID: Choose one dish for every part of {{comboName}}.
GUEST_ORDERING_DISABLED: Ordering from the QR menu is turned off.
TOO_MANY_ORDERS: Too many orders in a minute.
ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE_NOW: {{itemName}} is not served at this time.
ORDER_HAS_PAYMENTS: Part of this bill is already paid; refund it first.
ITEM_PAID: This dish is on a paid bill; refund it instead.
PAYMENT_TOO_HIGH: That is more than is left to pay.
REFUND_TOO_HIGH: That is more than was paid.
SPLIT_INVALID: This split does not work. Check the dishes and amounts.
CASH_DRAWER_CLOSED: Open the cash drawer first (Till → Cash drawer).
CASH_DRAWER_OPEN: Count and close the cash drawer first.
BUSINESS_DAY_CLOSED: Today has been closed with a Z report.
DAY_HAS_OPEN_TABLES: Close every table and order first.
